summary: Bossier Parish tower built 1946 on Giddens Hill near Fillmore; crew based there 1947-1951; moved onto Barksdale AFB by August 1976; sources disagree on height.

facts.design: Four-legged all-steel tower with a cabin on top
facts.status_note: Moved onto the Barksdale AFB reservation before August 1976, per a Shreveport Journal item quoted on the lookout history site; sources disagree on height

events.note: June 1946 report announced a 100-foot all-steel tower; November 1946 reports call it a completed job
Towerman Josh Matlock and his wife moved into a new house on Giddens Hill
Melvin D. McMahon started work as crew leader based at the Giddens Hill tower
Coast and Geodetic Survey described the station; overall height about 125 feet, which conflicts with the 1946 reports
Tower moved onto the Barksdale AFB reservation; the August 1976 item does not give the date of the move

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Sources spell the hill Giddens Hill, Giddens' Hill and Gidden Hill; the story uses Giddens Hill.

notes_for_editor: Height conflict left open: 100 ft in the June 1946 plan, about 99 ft 9 in in a November 1946 report, 97 ft in a second November report, about 125 ft in the 1969 NGS description (NGS CQ3250 is listed only as non-publishable, no geodetic control). Brief height_m 30.5 kept. Barksdale location rests on the 1976 item plus one Facebook group post whose text we could read only as a headline, so today's status is weak. Brief status changed to relocated (correction proposed). Brief coordinates are close to the NGS approximation.
